22 likes, 2 comments - jerusalemwallahtv on October 8, 2026: "Food is more than taste—it carries memories, traditions, and identity. ❤️🍽️

From mummy ke haath ka khana to nani ke haath ka khana, and the special dishes we associate with festivals, food keeps a piece of where we come from.

Israel’s food culture tells a similar story. 🇮🇱 Different communities brought their traditions, recipes, and ingredients from across the world. Over time, these influences adapted, blended, and evolved—creating a food culture that reflects the story of a people building a new home without leaving their roots behind.

Because sometimes, you don’t leave your culture behind. 
You add a new place to what you already carry. 🌍❤️
